research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Insmed is researching dry powder compositions of treprostinil prodrugs and spray dried treprostinil formulation for treating pulmonary hypertension and interstitial lung disease, along with prostacyclin compounds and methods of treatment using dry powder compositions of treprostinil prodrugs. It is also developing liposomal amikacin and other lipid-based compositions, systems, and large-scale manufacturing methods for aminoglycosides to treat pulmonary non-tuberculous mycobacterial infections and broader pulmonary infections. These efforts span inhaled prostacyclin therapy and advanced antiinfective delivery.

overview_description.description: Insmed Incorporated is a global biopharmaceutical company on a mission to transform the lives of patients with serious and rare diseases. Insmed's first commercial product is ARIKAYCE® (amikacin liposome inhalation suspension), which is approved in the United States for the treatment of Mycobacterium avium complex (MAC) lung disease as part of a combination antibacterial drug regimen for adult patients with limited or no alternative treatment options. MAC lung disease is a rare and often chronic infection that can cause irreversible lung damage and can be fatal. Insmed's earlier-stage clinical pipeline includes INS1007, a novel oral reversible inhibitor of dipeptidyl peptidase 1 with therapeutic potential in non-cystic fibrosis bronchiectasis and other inflammatory diseases, and INS1009, an inhaled formulation of a treprostinil prodrug that may offer a differentiated product profile for rare pulmonary disorders, including pulmonary arterial hypertension.
